nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Edwards
nbaInjuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

nbaInjuries.name: Stephen Curry
nbaInjuries.note: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Tyrese Maxey

nbaInjuries.note: Cunningham (knee) won't play in Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

nbaInjuries.name: Ty Jerome

nbaInjuries.name: Paolo Banchero
nbaInjuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Deni Avdija
nbaInjuries.note: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable ahead of Thursday's game against Milwaukee.

nbaInjuries.name: Scottie Barnes
nbaInjuries.note: Barnes (injury management) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Washington, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Alperen Sengun
nbaInjuries.note: Sengun (eye) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Pacers, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
